_note: The system-defaults SHAPE corpus (design-system.md Part 1, 'radius scale'). RATIFIED, NOT INVENTED: every web value is the value already shipping in packages/dom/src/theme.ts, read out of the sheet rather than chosen here. THE LAW THAT WAS MISSING: a rung is BOUND TO A CONTROL SIZE, not applied regardless. The defect this closes is a 40px button and a 56px card taking the same radius, which is why nothing read as belonging to one family. Each rung below declares the band it serves, so picking a radius is picking a size class rather than a number. The Apple column is `continuousCorner` because those platforms own the CURVE as well as the radius - a continuous corner is not a circular arc, and no CSS radius reproduces it, which is a named divergence rather than a gap. The Compose targets take the Material 3 shape scale. The web drift gate is packages/dom/test/theme.test.ts; the element layer is held to this vocabulary by packages/dom/test/design-system-gate.test.ts, which fails a literal on this axis inside @layer dsx-elements.

web.band: control-height-sm and below: chips, marks, inner corners
the 40px control band: buttons, fields, segments
a content card, which is taller than a control and reads rounder
a surface that meets a screen edge
a pill or a circle, where the radius is half the height by definition
